panels.title: Selected addressable passages
rows: The system definition combines machine-based operation, varying autonomy, possible adaptiveness and inference from inputs to outputs that can influence environments.
The listed recruitment and selection uses include targeted job advertising, analysis and filtering of applications, and evaluation of candidates. The list must be read with Article 6.

Annex III systems are classified as high-risk, subject to the paragraph 3 qualification concerning significant risk and the specified procedural, improvement, pattern-detection or preparatory tasks. Annex III profiling systems remain high-risk. A provider concluding that a system is not high-risk must document its assessment before market placement or service and comply with the stated registration obligation.

Instructions identify the provider and explain purpose, capabilities, limitations, tested performance, foreseeable risks and oversight. They also describe relevant maintenance and logging arrangements. Several information items are qualified by applicability, appropriateness or relevance.

Deployers retain automatically generated logs insofar as those logs are under their control. The period must suit the intended purpose and be at least six months, unless applicable Union or national law provides otherwise. Financial institutions have an additional documentation qualification.
